ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a cell diagram with a relatively thick outer boundary and an approximately rectangular outline, with multiple organelles labeled inside. The largest area in the middle of the cell is a light-colored, cavity-like large region. Reasoning: This rectangular structure with a cell-wall-like boundary matches a plant cell diagram. The storage structure that occupies most of the center of a plant cell is called the central vacuole, usually shortened to vacuole.
